users.title: Users
users.importHelp: Columns: employee_id, name, email, role, floor, card_number. The master key is employee_id.
users.importModeHelp: Skip leaves it untouched; Overwrite updates name, email, role, floor, and adds a card when provided. Existing passwords are not changed.
users.importPasswordNote: New users get the initial password 123456Ab and must change it on first login.
users.searchPlaceholder: Search name, email, or employee ID
users.employeeIdInvalid: Employee ID may only contain letters, numbers, dots, dashes, and underscores (max 40 characters).
users.employeeIdExists: This employee ID is already used.
users.cardExists: This card number is already registered.
users.cardLostError: Unable to mark the card as lost.
users.cardNumberHelp: This card is used for check-in and door access.
users.masterCardHelp: A master card can open every door.
users.masterCardNeedsCard: Enter a card number before flagging it as master.
users.floorHelp: Controls which rooms this user may book.
users.floorMissingNotice: {{count}} user(s) have no floor group and cannot book rooms until one is set.
users.passwordRule: Password must be at least 8 characters.
users.passwordTooShort: Password is too short — at least 8 characters are required.
users.mustChangePassword: Require password change at next login
users.mustChangePasswordHelp: The user must set a new password before using the CMS.
users.protectedRoleHelp: The setup account keeps the Super Admin role.

settings.title: Global settings
settings.description: Timers and kiosk behaviour applied to every room.
settings.checkInLimitHelp: Minutes after the meeting starts before a booking without check-in is released.
settings.startSoonHelp: Minutes before the meeting starts when check-in becomes available.
settings.lockTimerHelp: Minutes before the kiosk returns to its idle screen.
settings.ledTimerHelp: Minutes the room indicator light stays on.
settings.tableInputHelp: Show the table input screen on the kiosk.
settings.weekStartHelp: Used by the calendar grid and the weekly query range.
settings.backupHelp: Enable daily backups from the CMS. The path must be absolute and writable by the server process (Docker: /backups volume).
settings.invalidWeekStart: Choose a valid first day of the week.
settings.invalidNumber: Enter a whole number greater than 0 for every timer.
settings.selfSignupHelp: When off, the Sign Up button and the /signup page are hidden, and the server rejects public registrations. Create employee accounts under Users instead.

about.title: About RoomBooking
about.intro: RoomBooking is a meeting-room booking system for The Prasada. This page lists the direct third-party libraries bundled with the CMS/API and the kiosk APK.
